issues.description: The problem statement is internally inconsistent about the SealSaloon.stock attribute: one section describes it as a final instance field initialized in the constructor, while a later note explicitly requires the stock attribute to be static (shared across all instances). This contradiction will confuse students about whether to implement stock as an instance final field or as a static field.
issues.suggestedFix: Clarify the specification in problem_statement.md so it consistently states whether stock is an instance final field or a static shared field. Preferably keep the intended design (a single shared Stock) and update the earlier paragraph to say a static final Stock stock is used and initialized (e.g., inline or in a static initializer), or remove the later note if the design should be an instance final field.

issues.description: The problem specification and UML require a static method named calculateTotalPrice(Meal): int, but the solution implementation provides a static method named computeMealCost(Meal) and the solution Main and solution SealSaloon are inconsistent in which name they call/use. This name/signature mismatch between specification, solution class, and solution Main will confuse students about the expected method name to implement.
issues.suggestedFix: Unify the method name across the specification, template, and solution. Rename the solution method computeMealCost to calculateTotalPrice (or update the problem statement/UML to use computeMealCost). Also ensure Main uses the same method name. Update any references in comments/examples to the chosen name so students know the exact method to implement.

issues.description: The problem statement requires a method named calculateTotalPrice(Meal) on SealSaloon, but the template/example code and the solution implementation use the name computeMealCost in different places. Template Main calls computeMealCost, SealSaloon in the solution defines computeMealCost, while the solution's Main (comment) calls calculateTotalPrice. This divergence between calculateTotalPrice and computeMealCost across problem_statement.md, the template, and the solution creates confusion about the expected method name and makes it harder for students to map the requirement to the provided code.
issues.suggestedFix: Unify the method name across all artifacts. Either rename computeMealCost to calculateTotalPrice in SealSaloon (and update all calls in Main and template comments), or change the problem statement to reference computeMealCost. Prefer matching the problem statement (calculateTotalPrice) so students can directly implement the required method name.
